# nobus_instance_from_volume (Resource)

Create a Nobus instance from an existing volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nobus_instance_from_volume" "web" {
  name      = "web-from-vol"
  image     = "ubuntu-22-04"
  flavor    = "small"
  key_name  = "operations"
  volume_id = "vol-123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flavor` (String)
- `image` (String)
- `key_name` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `volume_id` (String)

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `delete_volume_on_destroy` (Boolean)
- `network_id` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `security_groups` (List of String)
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive)
- `volume_size` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Nobus instance ID.
